description: Opt-in recall over local coding-session transcripts, including older sessions and other projects. Index persists under ~/.cache/deja; recalled text is sent to the connected model. Enable only with permission to read those histories; configure source/project exclusions for private sessions. Reviewed package version is pinned and offline mode is set. No LLM, embeddings or API key required by the local index. Not enabled by default.
name: deja-vu
